opportunities.name: Company account brief: SEC 10-K lookup, Wikipedia, email
opportunities.description: For a given ticker, find the latest 10-K on SEC EDGAR, look up the company on Wikipedia, and email a brief summary to a recipient.
steps: Search ticker in SEC EDGAR company search and select the match
Open Form filter and open the latest 10-K annual report
Search company name on Wikipedia and open the article
Note HQ, employees, CEO and 10-K filing date
Compose email with recipient, subject 'Account brief: Company (TICKER)' and summary body

opportunities.description: Compare two cities in the timeanddate time zone converter, look up the country's holidays for a month, and email ops a sync note with time difference and dates to avoid.
steps: Open Time Zones > Time Zone Converter
Add city A and city B via search
Open Calendar > Holidays and select the country
Open the holiday list for the year and note holidays in the target month
Compose email to ops with subject 'Sync: A / B, Month' and body with time difference and dates to avoid
